Inspect these control-specific outputs: Local design; corporate dependency; provider split; validation. Reperform the recorded decision or reconciliation and inspect a failure/exception path. Resolve exact source-level acceptance criteria before using this proposed test.
tasks.authored_procedure: Compare local and provider designs to the enterprise control; record the reason, responsibility split and additional measures; review changes and verify local evidence before accepting inheritance.
tasks.coverage_rule: Every authored instruction and clause must have an explicit performed/unperformed attribute; sharing evidence never creates automatic task credit.
tasks.external_final_dependency: Actual source applicability/design acceptance and independent qualified assurance signoff are not software outputs; normal documentary examination is automatable.
tasks.required_checks: Compare local/provider design and actual procedure execution to corporate responsibility split; inspect scoped additional measures, challenges and dated correction.
tasks.task_kind_rule: Walk one or more independently selected actual dated implementations through every authored step, linking actual grants/settings/actions and exceptions; approval alone is insufficient.
